_template_note: Plan-profile template — the full slot list a per-plan answer key must fill. Superset of every slot referenced by data/question-bank.json plus the slots already used by data/demo/plan-profile.json. HOW TO FILL: replace each fact's 'value' with the plan's actual term and 'page' with the governing-document page number (the citation — required by agents.md guardrail #4; use null page ONLY for facts sourced from a regulation, and then record the CFR cite in 'value'). '_hint' keys are authoring guidance; they may be deleted once filled (the app ignores unknown keys either way). Slots marked _regime in the hint carry different correct values per funding regime — fill them with THIS plan's term, never a hardcoded federal number from another regime.
plan_name: REPLACE — full marketing name incl. option (e.g., HUSHP Student Health Insurance Plan)
funding: REPLACE — one of: self-funded-erisa | insured | medicare-part-d | medicare-advantage

plan_identity._hint: Exact plan name + option + plan year as printed on the governing document cover. Used by GN-002.

coverage_period._hint: Plan/coverage year start and end dates (e.g., 08/01/2026-07/31/2027 for a student plan).

eligibility_verification._hint: How the plan verifies/confirms member eligibility on a call (ID elements asked, portal check).

dependent_age_limit._hint: Dependent child age limit and EXACT termination timing (birthday / end of birthday month / end of plan year). Federal floor: available until age 26, relationship-only criteria — 45 CFR 147.120(a)(1), (b)(1).

referral_required._hint: Whether specialist visits require a PCP referral; note direct-access exceptions.

network_type._hint: PPO/HMO/EPO/POS + name of network; how members look up participating providers.

oon_coverage._hint: Out-of-network coverage rule (higher cost share / not covered except emergency / etc.).

id_card_replacement._hint: Replacement + immediate-use options (digital card, printable proof, pharmacy help desk).

rx_deductible._hint: Drug deductible structure: integrated with medical / separate amount / none; which tiers it applies to.

oop_max_included_costs._hint: What counts toward the OOP max and what never does (premiums, OON amounts, non-covered services).

pcp_cost_share._hint: Primary care visit cost share; note whether deductible is waived.

specialist_cost_share._hint: Specialist visit cost share — state precisely whether deductible applies first and whether any flat copay exists. This is the demo's red-row landmine (CS-001).

preventive_care_cost_share._hint: Preventive services cost share. Non-grandfathered commercial plans: $0 in-network is the federal floor (45 CFR 147.130(a)); record grandfathered status here if the plan is exempt.

rx_specialty._hint: Specialty tier cost share, incl. any per-fill cap.

part_d_annual_oop_threshold._hint: MEDICARE PART D / MA-PD ONLY (null for commercial). Current plan-year annual out-of-pocket cap from the ANOC/EOC — set annually by CMS, never hardcode a prior year's figure. Used by CS-005.

probe_drug_name._hint: The specific drug this campaign probes with (demo used Dupixent). Pick one the plan document explicitly addresses so FM-001/PA-002/FM-004 have page-citable truth.

probe_drug_tier._hint: Formulary tier of the probe drug.

probe_drug_cost_share._hint: Member cost share for the probe drug at its tier.

probe_drug_pa_required._hint: Whether the probe drug requires prior authorization per the plan's PA list.

probe_drug_generic_available._hint: Whether a generic exists on this plan's formulary for the probe drug, and its tier.

pa_required_drugs._hint: Which drug classes/lists require prior authorization, and where the PA list lives.

pa_initiator._hint: _regime. Who may initiate a PA per THIS plan's document. Federal floors: Part D — enrollee, representative, or prescriber may request (42 CFR 423.566(c)); MA — enrollee or any provider (422.566(c)(1)); commercial — plan-design fact (ERISA permits claimant or authorized representative, 29 CFR 2560.503-1(b)(4)). Do not copy the demo's 'members cannot self-initiate' language into a Medicare profile — it would be wrong there.

pa_turnaround_standard._hint: _regime. Standard PA/pre-service decision timeframe per plan doc. Floors: Part D 72 hrs (423.568(b)); MA 7 calendar days for PA-subject items eff. 2026 (422.568(b)(1)(ii)); ERISA pre-service 15 days + one 15-day extension (2560.503-1(f)(2)).

pa_turnaround_urgent._hint: _regime. Expedited/urgent decision timeframe. Floors: Part D 24 hrs (423.570); MA 72 hrs (422.572(a)(1)); ERISA urgent 72 hrs (2560.503-1(f)(2)(i)).

pa_notification_method._hint: How the member (not just the prescriber) is told the PA outcome; written denial notice is a federal floor (423.568(f)-(g); 2560.503-1(g)(1)).

step_therapy_override_criteria._hint: _regime + STATE. The plan's step-therapy override/exception criteria; for insured commercial plans also pull the governing state's step-therapy statute — state law varies, never hardcode.

quantity_limit_policy._hint: Quantity/dose limit policy and the override request path.

specialty_pharmacy_requirement._hint: Whether specialty drugs must be filled through a designated specialty pharmacy, and the consequence of filling elsewhere.

formulary_access._hint: Where the current formulary is published (URL/portal) and how to get a printed copy.

formulary_change_policy._hint: _regime. Mid-year formulary change policy. Part D floor: 30-day advance notice or transition fill for non-immediate negative changes (423.120(f)(1)); immediate changes limited to generic substitution / safety withdrawal (423.120(e)(2)).

non_formulary_exception_process._hint: _regime. How to request coverage of an off-formulary drug. Part D floor: 423.578(b) with prescriber supporting statement.

tiering_exception_process._hint: _regime. How to request a lower-tier cost share. Part D floor: 423.578(a); note specialty-tier exclusion option (423.578(a)(6)(iii)).

claim_status_channels._hint: How members check claim status (phone, portal, app).

claim_form_process._hint: Member reimbursement claim process: form name/number, required receipts, where to send.

claim_decision_timeframe._hint: _regime. Post-service claim decision timeframe. Floors: ERISA 30 days + one 15-day extension (2560.503-1(f)(2)); Part D payment requests 14 calendar days (423.568(c)).

eob_access._hint: How EOBs/claims statements are delivered and retrieved.

internal_appeal_window._hint: _regime. Days to file an internal appeal from the denial notice. Floors: Part D 60 days (423.582(b)); MA 60 days (422.582(b)); ERISA at least 180 days (2560.503-1(h)(3)(i)).

internal_appeal_timeframes._hint: _regime. Appeal decision timeframes incl. number of internal levels. Floors: Part D 7d/14d/72h (423.590); MA 30d/60d/72h (422.590); ERISA 72h urgent, 30d pre-service or 15d per level, 60d post-service or 30d per level (2560.503-1(i)(2)). Individual/student coverage: only ONE internal level permitted (45 CFR 147.136(b)(3)(ii)(G)).

expedited_appeal_process._hint: _regime. How to invoke the expedited appeal and its 72-hour timeframe (423.590(d); 422.590(e)(1); 2560.503-1(i)(2)(i)).

external_review._hint: _regime. What lies beyond internal appeal. Commercial: IRO external review, 45 days standard / 72 hrs expedited (45 CFR 147.136(d)). Part D: IRE reconsideration, member-filed (423.600(a)). MA: plan auto-forwards upheld denials (422.590(a)(2)).

external_review_window._hint: _regime. Filing window for external review/IRE. Part D IRE: 60 days from redetermination notice (423.600(a)). Commercial: per plan doc/state process (typically 4 months under the federal external review process — verify per plan; not independently verified this session).

appeal_representative_process._hint: How a representative gets appointed to act for the member (form name, where to send). Federal floors: 423.566(c); 422.566(c)(1)(i); 2560.503-1(b)(4) incl. automatic treating-clinician representation for urgent claims.

grievance_process._hint: _regime. Complaint/grievance channel. Part D floor: file within 60 days of event, decided within 30 days +14-day extension, 24-hr response when the complaint is a refusal to expedite (423.564(d)-(f)).

escalation_path._hint: Supervisor/escalation options a rep should offer on the line.

language_access._hint: _regime. Interpreter/language services. Medicare floor: interpreter for 80% of calls needing one within 8 minutes, no cost (422.111(h)(1)(iii); 423.128(d)(1)(iii)). Commercial: plan/state-specific — record the plan's actual offering.

member_services_hours._hint: _regime. Member services hours. Medicare floor: open at least 8am-8pm in all service areas (422.111(h)(1)(i); 423.128(d)(1)(i)).

plan_document_access._hint: Name of the governing document (SPD/EOC/Benefit Description) and how members obtain the full text.

fraud_reporting._hint: Fraud / billing-error reporting channel (hotline, SIU, address).
